home.heroLead: We manage the nation's strategic assets professionally, transparently, and accountably to deliver the greatest benefit to society and our stakeholders.

about.title: Five decades contributing to national development
about.lead: Since its founding, the company has continuously transformed into a resilient and adaptive entity. Through good governance and continuous innovation, we serve as an agent of development while creating economic value.
body: The company is a State-Owned Enterprise operating in a nationally strategic sector. We carry out business activities that support government policy while generating sustainable economic value.
Backed by professional people and an operational network across Indonesia, we are committed to applying the principles of good corporate governance in every aspect of our business.
about.vision: To be a world-class company that makes the nation proud and adds value for Indonesia.
mission: Provide quality products and services that benefit society.
Manage the business professionally, efficiently, and with a focus on sustainable growth.
Contribute to national development and the well-being of surrounding communities.
